detail.longDescription: My Kubernetes manifests passed every check and still failed at deploy time. "Valid" describes the file; most deploy failures come from the cluster: no quota headroom, no node big enough, a missing Secret or CRD. I built k8s-guardian to check manifests against the live cluster, then ran it on 30 popular Helm charts. It found 5 bugs, all in my own tool. https:// zhukovskyi.space/blog/kube-too ling-why/ # Kubernetes # DevOps # Helm # OpenSource
